2609.02242.title: Propose to Learn, Learn to Propose: Evaluability-Aware Assistance under Bounded Rationality
2609.02242.paper_summary: AI assistants often collaborate by proposing candidate edits, plans, or designs that users evaluate before adoption. Existing assistance methods focus on proposal quality or user-goal inference, often assuming that the user can reliably evaluate any proposal, which can fail in practice because of bounded rationality. We study evaluability-aware proposal planning, where proposals serve both as task interventions and as probes for learning latent preferences and evaluation constraints, where the resulting belief updates then guide later proposals. We formalise this setting as ProSE, a hidden-parameter sequential assistance problem, and instantiate it with a KL-regularised bounded-rational binary response model in which acceptance trades off value gain against a distance-dependent evaluability penalty. Analysing the planning consequence of this likelihood reveals that likely accepted proposals and informative probes need not coincide, which explains why planners that only pursue acceptance systematically underperform. We operationalise ProSE with \textsc{ProSE-Plan}, a depth-2 Bayes-adaptive planner that scores proposals by possible responses and response-induced posterior beliefs. In controlled graph simulations, \textsc{ProSE-Plan} improves over evaluability-unaware and myopic baselines when evaluation cost is the bottleneck, and a probe-commit ablation confirms that our approach selects informative proposals that simpler methods miss. Our results thus identify user evaluability as a planning-relevant dimension of AI assistance, complementary to generation quality and preference inference.
2609.02242.paper_summary_zh: AI 助手經常通過提出候選編輯、計劃或設計來進行協作，這些提案需要用戶在採納之前進行評估。現有的輔助方法專注於提案質量或用戶目標推斷，通常假設用戶能夠可靠地評估任何提案，但在實踐中，由於有限理性，這種假設可能會失效。我們研究了可評估性意識的提案規劃，其中提案既作為任務干預，又作為學習潛在偏好和評估約束的探針，從而使得結果的信念更新能夠指導後續的提案。我們將這一設定形式化為 ProSE，一個隱藏參數的序列輔助問題，並用 KL 正則化的有限理性二元反應模型來具體化，其中接受與價值增益之間的權衡取決於距離的可評估性懲罰。分析這一似然的規劃後果顯示，可能被接受的提案和信息豐富的探針不必重合，這解釋了為什麼僅追求接受的規劃者系統性表現不佳。我們用 \textsc{ProSE-Plan} 操作化 ProSE，這是一個深度為 2 的貝葉斯自適應規劃器，通過可能的反應和反應引起的後驗信念來評分提案。在受控的圖形模擬中，\textsc{ProSE-Plan} 在評估成本成為瓶頸時，相比於不考慮可評估性和短視基準有了改進，而探針-承諾的消融實驗證實我們的方法選擇了簡單方法所忽略的信息豐富的提案。因此，我們的結果確定了用戶可評估性作為 AI 輔助的規劃相關維度，這與生成質量和偏好推斷互為補充。
